The second document of

Chronicles

Introduction

The Second Chronicles is a sequel of First Chronicles. It is written here the ruling of King Sulumun, the rebellion of the tribes there in the north (LIT left side) against_Rihubuwam who was the son of King Sulumun. That rebellion was spearheaded by Hirubuwam. It's written also here concerning the kingdom of Huda and the defeat of Hirusalim in 586 before Christ was_born.

What's_written(pl) in this document (LIT reading)

2 a. The first years \ior 1:1‑17\ior*

2 b. The building of the temple \ior 2:1‑7:10\ior*

2 c. The final years \ior 7:11‑9:31\ior*

1 The rebellion of tribes on south (LIT right side)\ior 10:1‑19\ior*

1 The kings of Huda \ior 11:1‑36:12\ior*
